expected_level_description: You can: - write and deliver a category strategy with budget holders and technical leads - plan the pipeline of procurements and contract renewals for the category - track savings, value, and risks for the category

You can: - buy cloud, software as a service, and clinical systems, choosing the right commercial model - build requirements with technical, clinical safety, and information governance leads - include interoperability, open standards, data ownership, and exit terms in contracts - avoid lock-in by planning for portability and competition at renewal

You can: - analyse a supply market, its competition, risks, and trends - lead early market engagement, such as supplier days, without distorting competition - use market evidence to shape requirements and commercial models

You can: - plan and lead negotiations, setting objectives, limits, and fallback positions - negotiate contract variations, renewals, and settlement of disputes - keep negotiations lawful and well recorded

You can: - plan and lead complex tenders, choosing the right route to market and procedure - help users write outcome-based specifications for digital and clinical systems - manage timetables, risks, and stakeholders through to contract award

You can: - advise on the lawful route for complex procurements and contract changes - manage the risk of challenge and handle standstill and debrief correctly - write procurement policy and guidance for the organisation

You can: - take responsibility for complex relationships with contracted suppliers - identify appropriate contractual frameworks and identify appropriate suppliers - negotiate with contracted suppliers - get good value out of contracts and suppliers

You can: - advocate for user needs, ensuring user value is balanced against cost and value for the organisation - determine the benefit of a product and persuade others it's the right product to use - write or contribute to business cases - communicate business-value propositions - help others make value-based decisions, influencing the direction of development

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
